text:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day Crosses $2 Billion, Setting Franchise Record - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:
Spider-Man: Brand New Day is the first Spider-Man movie to cross the coveted $2 billion-mark at the worldwide box office. The last entry, No Way Home, was the previous record-holder, with $1.9 billion. In related news, Marvel has revealed their recommended watchlist to prepare for Avengers: Doomsday, and it includes some older films such as the Fox-era X-men movies from the early 2000s. And finally, MCU star Simu Liu provided a small update on the long-in-development Sleeping Dogs movie.

TCG Card Shop Simulator - Official Version 1.0 Release Date Trailer
TCG Card Shop Simulator gets a new 90s Saturday morning cartoon-inspired trailer and a release date. Watch the 90s Saturday morning cartoon-inspired TCG Card Shop Simulator trailer for this management sim game. The new trailer also showcases store management gameplay and more. TCG Card Shop Simulator is out now in Early Access, and version 1.0 will be available on Steam, Xbox Series X/S, PlayStation 5 (PS5), Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on September 15, 2026.

In TCG Card Shop Simulator, open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop. Version 1.0 brings the playable Tetramon TCG, where players can battle with the cards they collect.

text:
Mortal Shell 2 - 11 Things To Know Before Playing
Mortal Shell 2 does not hold your hand. It offers a massive open world to explore, new systems and abilities to learn, shells to discover, and insanely aggressive enemies to take down. Not to mention, new sidearm weapons. Because Mortal Shell II introduces new systems and abilities, it’s important to learn how to utilize them so that you’re prepared for any challenge that comes your way. Here are 11 things you should know before playing Mortal Shell II. 

Timecodes:
00:50 - Stamina, No More
01:51 - Shell Bonding & Memories
03:51 - Seals Are Everything
05:33 - Fast Travel
06:24 - Cleansing Corruption
07:41 - Healing is Limited, But You Can Improve It
08:38 - Do NOT Ignore the Shop
09:10 - Upgrade Weapons Almost Immediately
10:15 - Tarstones
11:07 - Familiarity

Watch the 'Combat & Progression' Overview for Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, an upcoming remake of the original action-adventure game developed by Crystal Dynamics and Flying Wild Hog. Warfactory - Official Gameplay Overview Trailer
Get a deep dive into the gameplay of Warfactory in this latest trailer for the upcoming automation RTS where production defines the war effort. The new video gives a closer look at core elements of gameplay: manufacturing and combat. In Warfactory, build assembly lines to forge an army of machines, then feed thousands of units into massive real-time battles where every loss must be replaced by your factory. Warfactory will be available on PC in 2027. You can join the playtest via Steam if you're interested.

Take a look at the Final Trailer for Star Wars: Zero Company, a new strategy action Star Wars game developed by Bit Reactor. author: IGN YouTube
text:
Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 – Final Impressions Before the Review
Aliens: Fireteam Elite 2 seems like one of those lazy Sunday games, where you kill part of an afternoon playing a couple hours with friends. It gets Aliens and understands that forty miles of bad road Cameron envisioned. As a co-op game, it’s not going to change the world. Aliens already did that. But it’s a great excuse to play around in that world again, and I’m eager to see what else LV-558 has in store. Previewed by Will Borger

Final Fantasy Resonance - Official Vision: Onion Knight Trailer
Watch the Vision: Onion Knight Trailer for Final Fantasy Resonance, an upcoming HD 2D turn-based RPG developed by Square Enix. Players can summon the legendary Onion Knight into battle, originally debuted in Final Fantasy 3. Take out enemies with Onion Knight in Final Fantasy Resonance, launching on October 22 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
